subject.en: Dunhuang-mural chameleon head with a cinnabar ribbon, entering from the left edge
subject.zh: 敦煌壁画风的变色龙头部，系丹砂飘带，自左缘入画

description.en: The head enters diagonally from the left edge as if it had just climbed into the viewfinder; the empty right half is the subject, not leftover margin. 64% of the canvas stays clear.
description.zh: 头部自左缘斜着入画，像刚爬进取景框；右侧整片留白是构图主体，不是剩余边距，画布 64% 保持空。

title.en: Dunhuang mineral pigment, not a faceted mascot
title.zh: 敦煌矿物颜料，而非切面吉祥物

description.en: Azurite crest, malachite cheek band, cinnabar ribbon and gold-leaf flecks inside fine dark ink outlines, with pigment granulation and weathered flecks. The animal-family flat polygon facets were explicitly withdrawn for this project.
description.zh: 石青冠背、石绿颊带、丹砂飘带与金箔斑点，以细墨线勾勒，带颜料颗粒与剥落感。项目明确放弃家族平面切面画法。

description.en: A sand plaster field with hairline drying cracks, a lifting plaster edge and three pigment flecks, plus paper grain and one soft contact shadow. It follows the site's sand-and-mineral surface rather than a generic icon tile.
description.zh: 砂壁底纹配细裂缝、翻边与三处颜料斑点，另加纸面颗粒与一层柔和投影，呼应站点的砂岩与矿物表面，而非通用图标底板。

sizeNote.en: At 64 px the azurite crest, the cinnabar ribbon and the eye still read; at 32 px the mark becomes a two-tone silhouette of crest and ribbon, and gold flecks and scale texture merge. Small marks therefore use the transparent foreground without a tile.
sizeNote.zh: 64px 时石青冠背、丹砂飘带与眼仍可辨；32px 时只剩冠背与飘带的双色剪影，金箔与鳞纹会糊在一起。因此小尺寸标记使用无底板的透明前景。

source.description: A Chinese-cultural colour atlas with curated palettes and agent briefs

goal.en: Turn an original cultural image into a curated palette, a semantic website theme and a self-contained brief an agent can implement. Every palette ships with six swatches, twelve semantic roles, proportions, a live preview and CSS or agent-prompt export.
goal.zh: 把原创文化意象转成策展色板、语义化站点主题，以及 Agent 可直接落地的主题简报；每套配色都带六个色值、十二个语义角色、用色比例、实时预览与 CSS / Agent Prompt 导出。

role.en: Editorial collection explorer and live theme preview
role.zh: 策展图谱浏览与主题实时预览

role.en: Colour conversion, contrast and export calculations
role.zh: 色彩转换、对比度校验与导出计算
策展前的原创文化意象图像

description.en: Aged plaster with hairline cracks and restrained mineral flecks across the whole sheet.
description.zh: 斑驳砂壁，细裂纹与克制的矿物斑点铺满整张。
